'''Marie-Françoise Roy''' (born 28 April 1950 in [[Paris]]) is a French [[Mathematicians|mathematician]] noted for her work in [[real algebraic geometry]]. She has been Professor of Mathematics at the [[University of Rennes|University of Rennes 1]] since 1985 and in 2009 was made a ''Chevalier'' of the French [[Legion of Honour]].<ref>''[[Journal officiel de la République française]]'' (1 January 2009). [http://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/affichTexte.do?dateTexte=&categorieLien=id&cidTexte=JORFTEXT000020020329&fastPos=3&fastReqId=196080316&oldAction=rechExpTexteJorf "Décret du 31 décembre 2008 portant promotion et nomination"], p. 15.</ref> In 2004, she received an [[Irène Joliot-Curie Prize]].

==Research==
Roy works in [[real algebraic geometry]] in particular real spectra and, most recently, in complexity of [[algorithms]] in real algebraic geometry and also the applications.<ref>[http://www.espace-sciences.org/archives/science/13583.html Interview in la revue de l'espace de sciences (in French)]</ref>

==Education and career==
Marie-Françoise Roy got her education at [[École Normale Supérieure]] [[École normale supérieure de jeunes filles|de jeunes filles]] and was an assistant professor at [[Paris 13 University|Université Paris Nord]] during 1973.<ref>[https://www.ihes.fr/~carbone/papers/women.pdf Women in Mathematics...Why not You? Exhibition in 16 portraits. p.20]</ref> She received her PhD at [[Paris 13 University|Université Paris Nord]] in 1980, supervised by [[Jean Bénabou]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=64165}}</ref>

From 1981 she spent two years at [[Abdou Moumouni University]] in [[Niger]]. In 1985 she became a professor at [[University of Rennes|University of Rennes 1]] in [[Rennes]], [[France]].

==Service==
Roy was president of [[Société Mathématique de France]] from 2004 to 2007.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://smf.emath.fr/content/anciens-presidents |title=Past presidents of Société Mathématique de France (in French) |access-date=2013-07-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161024023304/http://smf.emath.fr/content/anciens-presidents |archive-date=2016-10-24 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

In 1986, Roy was one of the founders<ref>[http://www.drivehq.com/file/df.aspx?isGallary=true&shareID=8755087&fileID=748744287 Newsletter of the AWM, October 1986] p.1</ref> of [[European Women in Mathematics]] (EWM), and was the convenor (president) of EWM 2009–2013.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.europeanwomeninmaths.org/women-in-math/portrait/marie-francoise-roy |title=EWM, Portrait of Marie-Francoise Roy |access-date=2013-07-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161022221536/http://www.europeanwomeninmaths.org/women-in-math/portrait/marie-francoise-roy |archive-date=2016-10-22 |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 1987 she co-founded the French organization for women in mathematics, [[L'association femmes et mathématiques|Femmes et Mathématiques]], and became the organization's first president.

Roy is scientific officer for Sub-Saharan Africa in Centre International de Mathématiques Pures et Appliquées, CIMPA.<ref>[http://www.cimpa-icpam.org/spip.php?rubrique45&lang=en CIMPA website]</ref> Roy is president of Association d'Echanges Culturels Cesson Dankassari (Tarbiyya-Tatali) an organization working for joint activities in a commune [[Dan-Kassari|Dan-Cassari]] in [[Niger]] and the French commune [[Cesson-Sévigné]].

== Honours and awards ==
In December 2022, Roy was awarded an [[Honorary Doctorate]] of Science (DSc) by the [[University of Bath]]. The award recognises Marie-Françoise's work both in algebraic geometry, but also 'as a leading activist for the cause of women in mathematics, and [as] one of the most prominent and effective advocates for African mathematics.'<ref>{{Cite web |title=Marie-Françoise Roy: oration |url=https://www.bath.ac.uk/corporate-information/marie-francoise-roy-oration/ |access-date=2025-09-23 |website=www.bath.ac.uk}}</ref>

== Selected publications ==
* with Saugata Basu, Richard Pollack: [https://books.google.com/books?id=ecwGevUijK4C  ''Algorithms in real algebraic geometry.'' Springer 2003.][http://perso.univ-rennes1.fr/marie-francoise.roy/bpr-ed2-posted2.pdf pdf-file freely available on author's homepage] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120109230108/http://perso.univ-rennes1.fr/marie-francoise.roy/bpr-ed2-posted2.pdf |date=2012-01-09 }}
* with Jacek Bochnak, Michel Coste: ''Real algebraic geometry.'' 2.Edition, Springer, Ergebnisse der Mathematik Bd. 36, 1998 (first in French 1. Edition 1987).
* ''Three Problems in real algebraic geometry and their descendants.'' In: Engquist, Schmid: ''Mathematics unlimited- 2001 and beyond.'' Springer Verlag 2000, S. 991 (Hilberts 17th Problem, Algorithms, Topology of real algebraic varieties).
* ''Géométrie algébrique réelle.'' In: [[Jean-Paul Pier]] (Hrsg.): ''Development of Mathematics 1950-2000.'' Birkhäuser 2000.
* ''Introduction a la geometrie algebrique reelle'', Cahiers Sem. Hist. Math., 1991, [https://web.archive.org/web/20120712062723/http://numdam.org/numdam-bin/feuilleter?id=CSHM_1991_2_1_ Online]
